4月の工場 P-03 の不良率\n工場 P-03 の 4月 の不良率\nP-03:
SELECT 
    p.plant_id,
    p.plant_name,
    YEAR(q.inspection_date) AS year,
    MONTH(q.inspection_date) AS month,
    SUM(q.inspected_qty) AS inspected_qty,
    SUM(q.defect_qty)    AS defect_qty,
    CAST(SUM(q.defect_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.inspected_qty), 0) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) AS defect_rate
FROM dbo.fact_quality_inspections q
JOIN dbo.dim_plant p ON p.plant_id = q.plant_id
WHERE q.plant_id = 'P-03'
  AND MONTH(q.inspection_date) = 4
  AND YEAR(q.inspection_date) = (
      SELECT MAX(YEAR(inspection_date))
      FROM dbo.fact_quality_inspections
      WHERE MONTH(inspection_date) = 4
  )
GROUP BY p.plant_id, p.plant_name, YEAR(q.inspection_date), MONTH(q.inspection_date);
不良率が前月比で悪化した工場は？:
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        plant_id,
        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(inspection_date), MONTH(inspection_date), 1) AS ym,
        SUM(inspected_qty) AS insp_qty,
        SUM(defect_qty)    AS def_qty
    FROM dbo.fact_quality_inspections
    GROUP BY plant_id,
             DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(inspection_date), MONTH(inspection_date), 1)
),
rated AS (
    SELECT
        plant_id, ym,
        CAST(def_qty * 1.0 / NULLIF(insp_qty,0) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) AS defect_rate,
        LAG(CAST(def_qty * 1.0 / NULLIF(insp_qty,0) AS DECIMAL(10,4)))
            OVER (PARTITION BY plant_id ORDER BY ym) AS prev_defect_rate
    FROM monthly
),
latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(ym) AS latest_ym FROM monthly
)
SELECT  r.plant_id,
        p.plant_name,
        r.ym,
        r.defect_rate,
        r.prev_defect_rate,
        (r.defect_rate - r.prev_defect_rate) AS delta
FROM rated r
JOIN dim_plant p ON p.plant_id = r.plant_id
JOIN latest    l ON r.ym       = l.latest_ym
WHERE r.defect_rate > r.prev_defect_rate
ORDER BY delta DESC;
サプライヤー遅延と完成品の生産遅延の相関は？:
WITH supplier_delay_monthly AS (
    SELECT 
        FORMAT(g.actual_receipt_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS ym,
        AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(day, p.promised_date, g.actual_receipt_date) AS FLOAT)) AS avg_supplier_delay
    FROM dbo.fact_goods_receipts g
    JOIN dbo.fact_purchase_orders p ON p.po_id = g.po_id
    GROUP BY FORMAT(g.actual_receipt_date, 'yyyy-MM')
),
production_delay_monthly AS (
    SELECT 
        FORMAT(actual_end_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS ym,
        AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(day, planned_end_date, actual_end_date) AS FLOAT)) AS avg_prod_delay
    FROM dbo.fact_production_orders
    WHERE actual_end_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY FORMAT(actual_end_date, 'yyyy-MM')
),
joined AS (
    SELECT s.ym, s.avg_supplier_delay, p.avg_prod_delay
    FROM supplier_delay_monthly s
    JOIN production_delay_monthly p ON s.ym = p.ym
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS n,
        SUM(avg_supplier_delay)              AS sx,
        SUM(avg_prod_delay)                  AS sy,
        SUM(avg_supplier_delay * avg_prod_delay) AS sxy,
        SUM(avg_supplier_delay * avg_supplier_delay) AS sxx,
        SUM(avg_prod_delay * avg_prod_delay)         AS syy
    FROM joined
)
SELECT 
    n AS months,
    CAST((n*sxy - sx*sy) /
         NULLIF(SQRT((n*sxx - sx*sx) * (n*syy - sy*sy)), 0)
         AS DECIMAL(10,4)) AS pearson_r
FROM stats;
DOI を定義どおりに計算して、上位5の完成品を返して:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT material_id, closing_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY material_id ORDER BY snapshot_date_key DESC) AS rn
    FROM dbo.fact_inventory_snapshot
),
current_inv AS (
    SELECT material_id, SUM(closing_qty) AS current_qty
    FROM latest_snapshot WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY material_id
),
avg_out AS (
    SELECT material_id, AVG(CAST(outbound_qty AS FLOAT)) AS avg_daily_outbound
    FROM dbo.fact_inventory_snapshot
    WHERE snapshot_date_key >= CAST(FORMAT(DATEADD(MONTH,-3,GETDATE()),'yyyyMMdd') AS INT)
    GROUP BY material_id
)
SELECT TOP 5 
    c.material_id, m.material_name, m.category,
    c.current_qty,
    CAST(o.avg_daily_outbound AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS avg_daily_outbound,
    CAST(c.current_qty / NULLIF(o.avg_daily_outbound,0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS doi_days
FROM current_inv c
JOIN avg_out o ON o.material_id = c.material_id
JOIN dbo.dim_material m ON m.material_id = c.material_id
WHERE o.avg_daily_outbound > 0
ORDER BY doi_days DESC;
サプライヤー S-0007 の直近90日の中央リードタイム日数は？:
WITH anchor AS (
    SELECT MAX(actual_receipt_date) AS max_dt
    FROM fact_goods_receipts
),
base AS (
    SELECT DATEDIFF(day, po.po_date, gr.actual_receipt_date) AS lead_time_days
    FROM fact_goods_receipts AS gr
    JOIN fact_purchase_orders AS po
        ON gr.po_id = po.po_id
    CROSS JOIN anchor AS a
    WHERE po.supplier_id = 'S-0007'
      AND gr.actual_receipt_date >= DATEADD(day, -90, a.max_dt)
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(lead_time_days AS FLOAT)) OVER () AS median_lt_days
FROM base;
DOI が 60 日を超える完成品（FG）上位10は？:
WITH anchor AS (
    SELECT MAX(shipment_date) AS max_dt FROM fact_shipments
),
prod AS (   -- 累積生産量
    SELECT product_id, SUM(produced_qty) AS produced_total
    FROM fact_production_orders
    GROUP BY product_id
),
ship AS (   -- 累積出荷量
    SELECT product_id, SUM(shipped_qty) AS shipped_total
    FROM fact_shipments
    GROUP BY product_id
),
demand AS ( -- 直近30日日次平均
    SELECT s.product_id,
           SUM(s.shipped_qty) * 1.0 / 30 AS avg_daily_demand
    FROM fact_shipments s
    CROSS JOIN anchor a
    WHERE s.shipment_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, a.max_dt)
    GROUP BY s.product_id
)
SELECT TOP 10
    p.product_id,
    (p.produced_total - ISNULL(s.shipped_total,0)) AS on_hand_qty,
    CAST((p.produced_total - ISNULL(s.shipped_total,0))
         / NULLIF(d.avg_daily_demand,0) AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS doi_days
FROM prod p
LEFT JOIN ship s ON p.product_id = s.product_id
JOIN demand d    ON p.product_id = d.product_id
WHERE d.avg_daily_demand > 0
  AND (p.produced_total - ISNULL(s.shipped_total,0)) / NULLIF(d.avg_daily_demand,0) > 60
ORDER BY doi_days DESC;
生産遅延 3件以上の完成品:
SELECT product_id,
       COUNT(*) AS delay_count
FROM fact_production_orders
WHERE actual_end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND actual_end_date > planned_end_date
GROUP BY product_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY delay_count DESC;
